_comment: AUTHORED OWNERSHIP DECISIONS for BSB50420. Every family in families/MVC-BSB50420.families.json appears exactly once below.
_deliveredNote: Twelve units over 52 weeks, all delivered, no credit-transfer pathway, in the order BSBCMM511, BSBCRT511, BSBLDR523, BSBOPS502, BSBPEF502, BSBTWK502, BSBSUS511, BSBSTR502, BSBWHS521, BSBTEC404, BSBOPS501, BSBFIN501. Only two overlaps were detected across the whole qualification - management units drawn from different competency fields share far less scaffolding than a trade qualification does.

topics.name: Confidentiality of information and the policies that govern it
topics.rationale: Three units require the learner to handle information in accordance with organisational confidentiality policy - communicating with influence, managing workplace relationships, and collaborating through digital tools. BSBCMM511 Communicate with influence opens the course and is where a learner first has to judge what may be said and to whom.
topics.teachingRule: BSBLDR523 applies it to a relationship or a grievance and BSBTEC404 to what may be posted in a shared digital workspace. Neither re-teaches what the policy is or why it binds.
topics.ownerBenchmark: A satisfactory answer identifies what information is confidential, names the policy and any legislation governing it, and states how it is stored, shared and disposed of, and what a breach requires.
topics.benchmarkProvenance: draft 2026-09-09 - authored from the training.gov.au anchor, NOT yet validated by a subject matter expert

topics.name: Managing resource acquisition
topics.rationale: BSBOPS502 Manage business operational plans is delivered fourth and acquires resources as part of executing a plan. BSBOPS501 Manage business resources, delivered eleventh, carries the same element. The acquisition process - specify, source, approve, receive - is one process taught where it is first needed.
topics.teachingRule: BSBOPS501 teaches what is new to it: the resource lifecycle beyond acquisition - allocation, monitoring of use, maintenance and disposal - and cites BSBOPS502 for the acquisition step.
topics.ownerBenchmark: A satisfactory answer identifies the resource requirement against the plan, states how it is sourced and approved within delegation, and how acquisition is monitored against budget.
